gaps.sentence: The new policy was introduced ___ response to rising demand.
gaps.explanation: 'in response to' = as a reaction to.

gaps.sentence: The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.

gaps.sentence: Profits rose ___ 40 per cent, far beyond even the optimistic forecasts.
gaps.explanation: 'By' expresses the size of the increase: rose by 40 per cent.

gaps.sentence: The play closed after three nights ___ account of poor ticket sales.
gaps.explanation: 'On account of' = because of, in a formal register.

gaps.sentence: The bridge finally opened ___ traffic after a decade of delays.
gaps.explanation: 'Open to traffic' = become available for vehicles to use.

gaps.sentence: ___ any rate, we still have enough time.
gaps.explanation: 'At any rate' = whatever else is true.

gaps.sentence: The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: She opened the letter ___ trembling hands.
